quest.title: Fragmented Testimony
quest.description: You've heard that Alhaitham has become the Acting Grand Sage. Considering his personality, will the other scholars accept him? Time to pay the Akademiya a visit.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Mora x27825, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

dialogues.speaker: Rancho
dialogues.text: How's everything going with your thesis?

dialogues.speaker: Piah
dialogues.text: I should be able to publish it next month. *sigh* A few days ago, I was worried that I'd have to stop my work on it. Thankfully, that didn't come to pass.

dialogues.speaker: Rancho
dialogues.text: Well, Azar was one of your thesis advisers — honestly, I was afraid that you might have gotten dragged down as well. How did things get settled?

dialogues.speaker: Piah
dialogues.text: The newly-appointed Acting Grand Sage reviewed all of our projects and gave us permission to continue our research.

dialogues.speaker: Rancho
dialogues.text: Acting Grand Sage? That sounds like a new thing.

dialogues.speaker: Piah
dialogues.text: Yeah, I heard that selecting new sages has been taking some time, so he's just filling in.

dialogues.speaker: Piah
dialogues.text: But it's all thanks to him that our research results weren't jeopardized...

dialogues.speaker: Piah
dialogues.text: Once my paper is published, I'm definitely giving myself a long vacation and getting some much-needed rest. Mondstadt sounds like a good idea...

dialogues.speaker: Rajkumar
dialogues.text: They're really out of their minds, making Alhaitham the Acting Grand Sage...

dialogues.speaker: Rehan
dialogues.text: Take it easy, Professor. I'm puzzled as well. Just going by qualifications, you're one of our most preeminent scholars. I don't know why they picked a stripling like him...

dialogues.speaker: Rajkumar
dialogues.text: Fool! Do you think I'm angry because I wasn't chosen for the position? No, it's because I don't understand why they chose HIM.

dialogues.speaker: Rajkumar
dialogues.text: He was one of my students, but he rarely attended class. When I asked him about it, he retorted that self-study was better use of his time...

dialogues.speaker: Rajkumar
dialogues.text: What brazen arrogance! Misery of miseries... for the Akademiya to have him as the Acting Grand Sage!? *cough* *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Rehan
dialogues.text: Professor, don't get so worked up. I'll go get you some water!

dialogues.speaker: Rezakhani
dialogues.text: Psst... Wanna hear a secret? I've heard the new Acting Grand Sage is from Haravatat!

dialogues.speaker: Fariba
dialogues.text: Really? Who is it?

dialogues.speaker: Rowshan
dialogues.text: Someone named Alhaitham. Never met him myself, but he's a real hot topic right now — lots of things being said about him. Hard to tell what's true and what isn't, though.

dialogues.speaker: Rowshan
dialogues.text: There's also a Vahumana scholar who's been in the spotlight recently. They say that he's a likely pick to be one of the next sages.

dialogues.speaker: Fariba
dialogues.text: Oh, is he teaching any courses? Maybe we should drop by...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, news of Alhaitham being the Acting Grand Sage sure spread fast. Some people don't know who he is, though. Guess he's less famous than Paimon thought.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Some people are saying good things, and others bad... especially that old guy just now. He really doesn't like Alhaitham...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, are you okay? Uh, you don't look too good...
The matra...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The matra?

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: I'm Ilyas. I have to talk to a matra about something important...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In the state you're in? You shouldn't push yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why don't you tell us what happened, and we'll pass on your message to a matra.

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: No. I have to tell them myself. They are the only ones I can trust...

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: Sorry, can you lend me your arm...? This is an important matter. Failure is not an option.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Since you put it that way, fine, we'll take you to a matra!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, hey there! Excuse us, but is Cyno at the Akademiya?

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: You two look familiar. Are you friends of Mahamatra Cyno? Um, I'm afraid he's out on a mission right now.

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: But if you'd like, I can pass whatever message you might have on to him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We ran into this guy by the gates, and he seems really eager to speak with a matra. It sounds like something urgent.

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: Oh? If you don't mind, why don't you tell me about it first?

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: Siraj...

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: Siraj? That name sounds familiar. Isn't he a Vahumana researcher?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Vahumana researcher?

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: Yes, one of their most renowned, in fact. I hear he's as daring as he is intelligent.

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: There are rumors he'll become Vahumana's next sage... Uh, but please continue, good sir. What about Siraj?

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: I want to report him... for conducting a dangerous experiment.

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: He kidnapped me, tied me up, and took me to that horrible cave... Experimental equipment everywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: I ran as fast as I could... A little slower, and he would've caught me...

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: There's no rush. Please, take your time.

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: What kind of experiments was he conducting? Where is this cave?

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: I don't remember...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You can't remember?

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: All I remember is Siraj walking towards me, and then my head started feeling... weird.

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: It's like a nightmare that I can't recall... I just know that that place is dangerous and that they must be stopped!

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: Oh, I heard they conduct business in the tavern. We have to hurry...

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: Even if what you say is... *sigh* All right, I'll have some of my colleagues look into Siraj.

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: But before that, I would like to administer the matra lie detector test.

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: You think I'm lying?

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: Please don't take it the wrong way. This is just standard protocol.

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: Sorry, but can you two wait out here a little while? We'll be back soon.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You wait somewhat longer than expected...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Alhaitham?

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: Let me bring you up to speed. First things first, Ilyas passed the lie detector test.

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: This indicates that what he said is highly credible. As such, we've decided to launch an investigation based on the leads he provided.

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: Per protocol, this matter was reported to Acting Grand Sage Alhaitham. After hearing about it, he left a message for Mahamatra Cyno and then asked to join the investigation.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's kinda weird for you to be working with the matra. Is there a special reason?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: You're overthinking things. My interest was piqued, is all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Paimon's surprised you have this much free time...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #In that case... Let's join in as well, shall we, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: It's already against protocol for Acting Grand Sage Alhaitham to participate in this investigation. As for you two...

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: Oh, never mind. After all, you were the ones who brought Ilyas here. I'll allow you to accompany us, but you have to promise to keep everything confidential.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't you worry! Our lips are sealed!

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: All right. In that case, I'll fill you in on what we know so far.

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: Ilyas claimed that Siraj will be conducting some business with a Kshahrewar researcher at the tavern. This is one of his few clear memories. It seems he stumbled upon this information while escaping.

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: Incidentally, Siraj isn't at the Akademiya right now. He applied for long-term off-site research one month ago.

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: It's close to the time that Ilyas had given, so we've decided to head to the tavern and investigate any suspicious persons.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: That's right. Aarav, prepare to head out. You two, do as you will.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, come on! We already said that we're coming!

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: We're here, Acting Grand Sage Alhaitham. What's our next course of action?

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: Acting Grand Sage Alhaitham?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Looks like you haven't read any memos lately.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: The new Akademiya decree clearly states that even a sage doesn't have the authority to interfere with the matra's actions during an ongoing investigation.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: If your superior were here, he wouldn't be asking me what to do. Instead, he'd be telling me to stay out of the way.

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: ...You're right. Understood! Then, please wait here as we lock down the perimeter and search for suspicious persons!

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: Ilyas, please stay here. Acting Grand Sage Alhaitham, I'll have to trouble you with the protection of our primary witness.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Sure, though I'd rather he just protect himself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He's the same as ever... Casually ignoring people, just like he did back at Aaru Village!

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Answering a simplistic question only enables the questioner. Besides, I need him to understand my position clearly.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Aarav has just as many doubts about my coming along as you do.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: But unlike you two, he's making this matter more complicated than it is, with his considerations like "the Acting Grand Sage is trying to seize the matra's powers."

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: That question was obviously bait. The matra were once under the influence of the sages, and so were often subject to these bureaucratic traps.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: The test was strictly unnecessary, though. I hope that our exchange will assure him that I won't interfere with their work this time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Grr! Why is this so complicated!?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: This is why I was against becoming the Acting Grand Sage from the very first. Titles and rank inevitably make a lot of things more troublesome than usual.

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: Excuse me, Acting Grand Sage Alhaitham.

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: I've had a question on my mind and I need to know the answer, no matter what... Have we met before?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: No, I have no recollection of ever meeting you.

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: Haha, I thought so, too... I probably wouldn't have had anything to do with someone of your caliber.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Then why did you ask?

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: Well, for some reason, I felt a sense of familiarity when I met you for the first time.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Really?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: A misperception perhaps, or...

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: Acting Grand Sage Alhaitham, we've apprehended a suspect!

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Siraj?

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: No, it's the Kshahrewar researcher who has dealings with him. His name is Narendra.

dialogues.speaker: Narendra
dialogues.text: S—Acting Sage Alhaitham...?

dialogues.speaker: Narendra
dialogues.text: Wait, uh, can someone please explain what's going on? I admit that I did steal some mechanical components from the lab and sell them, but does something like that really warrant the personal interest of the Acting Grand Sage?

dialogues.speaker: Narendra
dialogues.text: What... What have I gotten myself into? I—I know I let greed get the best of me, but please, I promise that this won't ever happen again...

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: I would like to ask him a few questions.

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: Of course.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Do you know Siraj?

dialogues.speaker: Narendra
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's the name of my buyer. He asked to make the transaction at the tavern, but he never showed up...

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: What were the details of this transaction?

dialogues.speaker: Narendra
dialogues.text: He's doing some kind of experiment that seems to require many power generators and electrical components that can only be found in our project.

dialogues.speaker: Narendra
dialogues.text: He contacted me in private and said that he'd pay a large sum of Mora if I was willing to put some aside for him, under the pretense of them being defective parts.

dialogues.speaker: Narendra
dialogues.text: We had originally agreed to meet at the tavern earlier today to do the trade. I sure didn't expect to get stood up or run into you all...

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: Perhaps Siraj was aware that Ilyas might leak information, so he intentionally didn't show up. Whatever the case, it seems that this lead ends here.

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: The good news is regardless of what Siraj was planning, his progress will now be severely hindered by a lack of power generators and electrical components. We still have time to conduct our investigation.

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: Do you have any more questions for the suspect?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: No, he's all yours, but I'd like to borrow Ilyas for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: Oh, that's fine.

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: We conducted a comprehensive lie detection exam, which showed that he has a genuine case of amnesia. We're not planning to pursue any further breakthroughs on that front.

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: However, I am curious... What do you need him for, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: I've read some papers regarding amnesia, and I'd like to try restoring his memories.

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: I see... We'll be returning to the Akademiya, then. I'll leave Ilyas in your care.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Follow me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Siraj didn't show up at the tavern, and Narendra didn't give us any leads... That means we're stuck!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alhaitham, are you serious about seeing things through? Paimon's pretty surprised that you're this interested in the case...

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: I thought you would've guessed the reason by now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Paimon has no clue. Hey, do you know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you know Siraj?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Yes. We were classmates.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh, so that's why you asked to come along when Aarav briefed you on the situation!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you're not here because you're interested in the case itself, but because you know the suspect?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: You couldn't be further from the truth, but I wasn't expecting much from you to begin with.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: For the time being, all you need to know is that we were once classmates. I became the scribe afterwards, while he continued his academic endeavors.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: He submitted a thesis one year ago, and the Grand Sage at the time asked for my opinion. I did not approve of it because it committed one of the six cardinal sins by touching upon human evolution.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: From violating matters regarding human evolution to attempting the forbidden and fearing none, the six cardinal sins are the origin of all evil in this world. They are also what the sages use as a reference when formulating or amending the rules of the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: My opinion was that Siraj's research was both overly naive and in violation of various core principles. The Grand Sage took some of my suggestions on board and ultimately decided to reject the application.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that's why he's buying energy sources and electrical components...

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: He's most likely trying to circumvent the rules and conduct his experiment in secret.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That sounds super suspicious... We gotta stop him!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ilyas, can you try to remember things again? Maybe something new will pop up.

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, but I've already tried many times. And no matter how hard I try, it feels like everything in my mind is shrouded in a thick mist.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: It is possible for a person to subconsciously forget some of their memories as a defense mechanism against extreme stress.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: However, these memories aren't truly lost, but merely sealed away. They can be restored with the appropriate stimulus.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Now, try to recall things you care about. They don't need to be related to this case.

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: Actually... I feel like I've forgotten more than just the memories of the time I was kidnapped and experimented on.

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: The kind of person I am, the things I've done... I can remember some things, but I can't recall some others no matter how hard I try.

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: But, I do vaguely remember that there are two things that I have to do, no matter what.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Do tell.

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: The first is to get my paycheck from the Akademiya and give it to my younger sister in Gandharva Ville.

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: I'm not sure about the details... but it seems that I would send money to my younger sister every month to pay for family expenses.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And the second thing? What's the second thing?

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: ...I can't remember. Sorry, there's just so much I can't recall...

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Not unexpected.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: However, you're the only one who has seen Siraj and knows the exact location of his cave at present. As such, we'll do everything we can to help you regain your memories.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Losing your memories must be really painful, but don't you worry! We'll help you get them all back!

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: Thank you so much. This feeling... It's more than just pain, but I don't know how to describe it...

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: I have so few memories that I don't even have a clear idea of who I am... And my head's always ringing — it feels like I could faint at any moment.

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: But amidst all that... It also feels like I've been set free, somehow...

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: Nevertheless, I have you all to thank for bringing me what clarity I do have right now.

dialogues.speaker: Ilyas
dialogues.text: Now, I do remember that I worked part-time at a place in the Akademiya called the Research Preparation Center. That's also where I got my monthly paycheck.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: I see. In that case, let's go and find whoever's in charge there.

dialogues.speaker: Rancho
dialogues.text: Say, an old friend of mine is also in Mondstadt. Why don't we go together? We can even ask him to be our guide and show us around.

dialogues.speaker: Piah
dialogues.text: That sounds great! Thanks a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know, Paimon's heard that Alhaitham's been made Acting Grand Sage, but with that personality of his... hoo boy. Uh, you think things will be okay?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why don't we go to the Akademiya and ask around?

dialogues.speaker: Rancho
dialogues.text: (I wonder if things are going smoothly with her thesis...)

dialogues.speaker: Piah
dialogues.text: (*sigh*)

dialogues.speaker: Rancho
dialogues.text: (I wish I could travel to Mondstadt with her.)

dialogues.speaker: Piah
dialogues.text: (My long-awaited time off...)

dialogues.speaker: Aarav
dialogues.text: (There is no room for laziness if we wish to uphold order.)
